info.description: Command Center API. Sign in with POST /api/v1/auth/login; the session cookie authorizes every other /api/v1 route. Access comes from each user's team roles.

Person.description: A person as the signed-in user may see them. Outside the viewer's teams (unless they are an executive) restricted is true and email, location, timezone, workMode and status are null. Investors only see people in their own teams.

PersonInput.description: Creates a user in one team with that team's member role. They must replace the temporary password at first sign-in.

status.description: Leadership Lead only. Suspending signs the person out everywhere.

isCore.description: Core company team (seeded). Only an executive can edit or delete it.

history.description: Earlier turns, oldest first, alternating user then assistant

TeamRole.description: Role in one team. Each team kind offers a manager role (held by the lead) and a member role: LEADERSHIP Leadership Lead / Executive Member, TECHNICAL Team Manager / Team Member, BUSINESS Sales Manager / Sales Member, EXTERNAL Investor Relations Manager / Investor.

workMode.description: Null when hidden from the viewer.

sections.description: Navigation sections this user may open.

administer.description: Leadership Lead: manages every team, user and role.
